title: Seller Tenure Credit on the Pocketwire Business Profile Subscription
content:
**Term.** The subscription tenure credit on the monthly subscription of a Pocketwire Business Profile is 3.00 dollars for a profile at least 36 whole months old, 1.50 dollars for a profile at least 12 but fewer than 36 whole months old, and nothing for a younger profile. A profile's age in whole months counts a month once the same day of the month as its opening date is reached. The opening date is the date recorded on the profile.

| Age of the profile in whole months | Subscription tenure credit |
|---|---|
| 36 or more | USD 3.00 |
| 12 to 35 | USD 1.50 |
| fewer than 12 | none |

## Age cases (hypothetical opening date of 15 March 2023)

| Handling date | Whole months reached | Credit |
|---|---|---|
| 14 March 2024 | 11 | none |
| 15 March 2024 | 12 | USD 1.50 |
| 1 March 2026 | 35 | USD 1.50 |
| 15 March 2026 | 36 | USD 3.00 |
